**Step 3–4 – Items and area:** On the main plate, toast covers ~25% (123 cm²), avocado ~7% (34 cm²), and egg ~10% (49 cm²), totaling ~42%. The banana covers ~30% of its plate (~94 cm²); orange covers ~35% of its dish (~28 cm²); oatmeal fills the mug’s surface.

**Step 7 – Energy:** Using typical values for the foods as served gives about 560 kcal total.

**Step 8 – Sanity check:** These portions are consistent with the visible breakfast; water is excluded.
